title.zh: 汇丰公布香港稳定币名称「HSBC RedCoin」并计划分阶段推出
title.en: HSBC Names Hong Kong Stablecoin 'RedCoin' and Plans Phased Rollout

current_state.zh: 汇丰RedCoin已在PayMe向超过330万用户分阶段推出，支持P2P转账及逾10万家商户支付；代码RCHKD，运行于汇丰私有账本，初期约1020万美元流通并由1040万美元现金支撑，暂不受存款保障覆盖；计划年底前扩展至汇丰手机银行及代币化货币市场基金认购，首次独立储备认证预计在2026年第四季度之后。
current_state.en: HSBC's RedCoin is in phased rollout to more than 3.3 million PayMe users, supporting P2P transfers and payments at over 100,000 merchants; ticker RCHKD, running on HSBC's private ledger, with about $10.2 million circulating backed by $10.4 million in cash and no deposit protection coverage; HSBC plans to expand to its HK Mobile Banking app and tokenized money market fund subscriptions by year-end, with first independent reserve attestation expected after Q4 2026.

updates.title_zh: 【汇丰公布香港稳定币名称为「HSBC RedCoin」，计划分阶段推出】
updates.title_en: 【汇丰公布香港稳定币名称为「HSBC RedCoin」，计划分阶段推出】
updates.what_changed_zh: 汇丰银行将其即将推出的香港稳定币命名为HSBC RedCoin，并概述了分阶段推出的计划，先从P2P转账和商户支付开始，再扩展到企业和机构应用，并援引一项对1000多名本地客户的调查，显示稳定币认知度广泛。
updates.what_changed_en: HSBC named its upcoming Hong Kong stablecoin HSBC RedCoin and outlined a phased rollout starting with P2P transfers and merchant payments before expanding to corporate and institutional applications, citing a survey of over 1,000 local customers showing broad stablecoin awareness.

updates.title_zh: 汇丰RedCoin在香港推出前瞄准74%了解稳定币的用户
updates.title_en: HSBC RedCoin Targets 74% Stablecoin-Aware Users Ahead of Hong Kong Launch
updates.what_changed_zh: 汇丰银行正将其与港元挂钩的RedCoin稳定币定位为瞄准约74%了解稳定币的香港受访者，准备在该市新的发牌框架下推出。
updates.what_changed_en: HSBC is positioning its HKD-backed RedCoin stablecoin to target the roughly 74% of Hong Kong respondents aware of stablecoins ahead of an anticipated launch under the city's new licensing framework.

updates.title_zh: 汇丰推出港元支持的RedCoin稳定币，面向香港330万PayMe用户
updates.title_en: HSBC Launches HKD-Backed RedCoin Stablecoin for 3.3 Million PayMe Users in Hong
updates.what_changed_zh: 汇丰已于10月23日开始向超过330万PayMe用户推出其获香港金管局发牌的港元挂钩RedCoin稳定币，首阶段支持P2P转账和商户支付，并计划年底前通过手机银行应用接入代币化货币市场基金认购。
updates.what_changed_en: HSBC began rolling out its HKMA-licensed HKD-backed RedCoin stablecoin to more than 3.3 million PayMe users on October 23, starting with P2P transfers and merchant payments and planning to add tokenized money market fund subscriptions via its mobile banking app by year-end.
updates.current_state_zh: 汇丰的RedCoin稳定币已进入面向PayMe用户的分阶段推出阶段，首阶段支持P2P转账和商户支付，预计周末前全面可用，并计划年底前扩展至代币化货币市场基金认购。
updates.current_state_en: HSBC's RedCoin stablecoin is now in phased rollout to PayMe users, with initial P2P transfers and merchant payments, expected full availability before the weekend, and planned expansion to tokenized money market fund subscriptions by year-end.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: HSBC began rolling out its HKMA-licensed, Hong Kong dollar-backed RedCoin stablecoin to more than 3.3 million PayMe users on October 23, starting with peer-to-peer and merchant payments and with plans to add tokenized money market fund subscriptions via its mobile banking app by year-end.
updates.detailed_summary_en: HSBC began rolling out its HKMA-licensed, Hong Kong dollar-backed RedCoin stablecoin to more than 3.3 million PayMe users on October 23, starting with peer-to-peer and merchant payments and with plans to add tokenized money market fund subscriptions via its mobile banking app by year-end.

updates.title_zh: 香港最大银行向300万个钱包推出稳定币
updates.title_en: Hong Kong’s Biggest Bank Puts a Stablecoin in 3 Million Wallets
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充：RedCoin代码为RCHKD，PayMe首阶段覆盖逾10万家商户；发行初期约1020万美元RedCoin流通，由1040万美元现金全额支撑；代币运行于汇丰私有账本，PayMe与汇丰银行App间余额暂不能互转，且不受香港存款保障计划覆盖；首次独立储备认证预计在2026年第四季度之后。
updates.what_changed_en: The new report adds that RedCoin's ticker is RCHKD, the initial PayMe phase covers more than 100,000 merchants, roughly $10.2 million of RedCoin was circulating shortly after launch backed by $10.4 million in cash, the token runs on HSBC's private ledger, balances cannot yet move between PayMe and HSBC's banking app, it is not covered by Hong Kong's Deposit Protection Scheme, and the first independent reserve attestation is expected after Q4 2026.
updates.current_state_zh: 汇丰RedCoin已在PayMe向超过330万用户分阶段推出，支持P2P转账及逾10万家商户支付；代码RCHKD，运行于汇丰私有账本，初期约1020万美元流通并由1040万美元现金支撑，暂不受存款保障覆盖；计划年底前扩展至汇丰手机银行及代币化货币市场基金认购，首次独立储备认证预计在2026年第四季度之后。
updates.current_state_en: HSBC's RedCoin is in phased rollout to more than 3.3 million PayMe users, supporting P2P transfers and payments at over 100,000 merchants; ticker RCHKD, running on HSBC's private ledger, with about $10.2 million circulating backed by $10.4 million in cash and no deposit protection coverage; HSBC plans to expand to its HK Mobile Banking app and tokenized money market fund subscriptions by year-end, with first independent reserve attestation expected after Q4 2026.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: HSBC launched RedCoin, an HKMA-licensed Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, on its PayMe app, enabling 3.3 million-plus users to hold, transfer, and spend the token at over 100,000 merchants, with expansion into the HK Mobile Banking app and institutional use cases planned.
updates.detailed_summary_en: HSBC launched RedCoin, an HKMA-licensed Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, on its PayMe app, enabling 3.3 million-plus users to hold, transfer, and spend the token at over 100,000 merchants, with expansion into the HK Mobile Banking app and institutional use cases planned.
